# The Independent

> > Major UK news publication covering breaking news, entertainment, climate action, and lifestyle content, with integrated TV Guide listings and puzzle games.

The Independent delivers comprehensive journalism spanning international news (US-Iran relations, UN climate initiatives), entertainment coverage (Netflix, streaming guides, TV schedules), environmental reporting (Earth Day, World Economic Forum climate action), and lifestyle content. The site also features TV Guide integration for streaming recommendations and daily puzzle games by Arkadium.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News & International Relations
- Climate Action & Earth Day
- World Economic Forum
- Netflix & Streaming Services
- TV Guide & Entertainment Listings
- United Nations & IPCC
- Sustainability & Environmental Science
- Health & Aging Research
- Celebrity & Entertainment News
- Oscar Nominees & Film Reviews
- Astronomy & Earth Science
- Prime Video & Hulu
- Daily Puzzles & Games

## News & Current Affairs

- [US rejects Tehran's 'false' claim about Iranian warship sunk in submarine attack](https://independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/iran-war-us-iris-dena-warship-b2934577.html): US-Iran dispute over IRIS Dena warship sinking near Sri Lanka
- [How worrying about getting old is making you age faster](https://independent.co.uk/life-style/ageing-anxiety-biologically-older-telomeres-b2930940.html): NYU research on aging anxiety's biological effects on telomeres

## TV Guide & Streaming

- [TV Guide - Main Listings](https://tvguide.com): TV Guide homepage with streaming recommendations and entertainment news

- [The Complete Guide to Winter TV 2025-2026](https://tvguide.com/news/features/winter-tv-guide-2025): Comprehensive winter 2025-2026 TV season guide across all streamers
- [The 55 Best Shows on Netflix Right Now (March 2026)](https://tvguide.com/news/the-best-shows-on-netflix): Curated list of 55 best Netflix shows including Vladimir and Bridgerton
- [The 61 Best Movies on Netflix Right Now (March 2026)](https://tvguide.com/news/best-movies-on-netflix): 61 best Netflix movies featuring Jurassic World Rebirth and The Iron Claw
- [The 16 Best Movies to Watch on Peacock Right Now (March 2026)](https://tvguide.com/news/best-movies-on-peacock): 16 best Peacock movies including Oscar nominees Hamnet and Bugonia

## Climate & Environmental Coverage

- [Earth Day 2023: A guide to getting involved, from EcoWatch](https://weforum.org/stories/2023/04/the-ecowatch-guide-to-earth-day-2023): EcoWatch guide to Earth Day 2023 'Invest in Our Planet' events & actions
- [Earth Day: Here are 5 ways we can scale up climate solutions](https://weforum.org/stories/2023/04/earth-day-2023-climate-solutions-ipcc): 5 scalable climate solutions from IPCC report for Earth Day 2023
- [On Earth Day, a look at how climate change is impacting health](https://weforum.org/stories/2024/04/this-earth-day-we-consider-the-impact-of-climate-change-on-human-health-110b71b453): Earth Day 2024 analysis of climate change's impact on human health worldwide
- [The history of Earth Day](https://weforum.org/stories/2020/04/earth-day-50-anniversary-enviroment-nature): 50th anniversary retrospective on Earth Day origins from April 1970
- [How the birthplace of Earth Day became a climate innovation hub](https://weforum.org/stories/2025/04/earth-day-lessons-san-francisco-innovation-hub-climate-action): San Francisco's evolution as nature-positive climate innovation hub
- [Earth Overshoot Day: Human consumption vs biocapacity](https://weforum.org/stories/2023/08/earth-overshoot-day-human-consumption-biocapacity-ecological-footprint): Explaining Earth Overshoot Day when human consumption exceeds biocapacity

- [What is the average earth temperatures day and night?](https://answers.com/natural-sciences/What_is_the_average_earth_temperatures_day_and_night): Q&A on Earth's day-night cycle duration and temperature variations
